description: This file defines a trait 'DecryptionTrait' in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for handling decryption operations such as generating decrypting streams, processing cipher texts, and integrating with encryption metadata. It includes abstract methods for obtaining cipher details and providing concrete implementations for decrypting ciphertext streams using either GCM mode or other cipher modes.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of ciphertext by configuring cipher options and obtaining a decryption stream.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from the end of the ciphertext stream based on the specified tag length.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Returns a stream of ciphertext without the authentication tag, used in authentication mode.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Generates the appropriate decryption stream based on the cipher mode (e.g., GCM or others).
